content: {"insights":[{"title":"Severe performance drop post‑update","kind":"pain_point","theme_id":"apple-t42","body":"Users report their phones becoming unusably slow after the latest iOS update, with app launch times stretching to 30 seconds or more [#tk_704578]. Multiple complaints describe constant freezing and crashes that were absent before the update [#tk_2786453]. The issue is widespread, affecting over 3,400 users and accounting for 96% of negative sentiment in this theme [#tk_2949587]."},{"title":"Battery drains dramatically after iOS upgrade","kind":"pain_point","theme_id":"apple-t47","body":"After installing iOS 11.1.x, users see a 40‑50% battery loss within ten minutes, even in low‑power mode [#tk_2693996]. Similar reports mention rapid drain across different iPhone models and updates, confirming a systemic problem [#tk_2572074]. This problem impacts 2,420 users and represents 92.6% of negative feedback for the battery‑drain theme [#tk_332468]."},{"title":"Letter‑specific autocorrect bug","kind":"pain_point","theme_id":"apple-t39","body":"Customers are frustrated that typing the letter “i” is automatically replaced with an “A” or other symbols, breaking normal text entry [#tk_2345907]. A related issue swaps the letter “L” with an “l”, indicating a broader Unicode handling flaw [#tk_1510855]. The bug appears in nearly 2,000 complaints, making up 83% of negative sentiment for this UI/UX theme.","theme_id":"apple-t39"},{"title":"Purchased music disappears after cancel","kind":"pain_point","theme_id":"apple-t24","body":"Users who cancel their Apple Music subscription report that previously purchased tracks vanish from their library and only 30‑second previews remain [#tk_87214]. Additional feedback shows that iTunes on computers cannot download the full songs, leaving users unable to access their purchases [#tk_2285356]. This issue affects 1,562 users and accounts for 88.6% of negative sentiment in the bugs_errors category."}]}
